tasks.scenario: Planning a photography workshop for teenagers – email to teacher about priorities, practical organisation, affordability, and date.
tasks.purpose: Evaluate and justify priorities (technical skills vs. expressing ideas), choose a practical activity, suggest affordability, ask about date.
requiredContentPoints: preferred goal (technical skills or expressing ideas) with reason
preferred practical thing (exhibition visit or photographer talk) with reason
one way to make workshop affordable
tasks.originalitySelfCheck: Scenario unique: photography workshop planning, not used in any previous test. Email structure with notes panel, four distinct content points, no overlap with forbidden concepts.

tasks.scenario: Article for town website about a planned photography workshop for teenagers.
tasks.purpose: Assess effectiveness and recommend – give opinion on the workshop idea and suggest what to learn.
requiredContentPoints: opinion on whether the workshop is a good idea
what you would like to learn
tasks.originalitySelfCheck: Announcement format, two direct questions, no reused frame from previous tests. Topic distinct from any earlier article.

tasks.scenario: Story beginning with a specific sentence about a memory card and note found in a camera bag during a photography workshop.
tasks.purpose: Analyse implications and propose action – continue the story from the given opening.
requiredContentPoints: the main photography workshop issue (implied by the opening)
a justified recommendation (implied by story resolution)
tasks.originalitySelfCheck: Opening sentence unique: involves a memory card and note, not used in any existing test. No resemblance to previous story openings.

overallOriginalityCheck: All tasks are original, no reused scenarios, no forbidden concepts, no generic phrases. Design matches designFingerprint exactly.
